# Managing My Account {-}

You can manage your personal information, account information, notifications, sponsors, and sponsored researchers in your account settings by clicking on the pencil icon.

```{r echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics("img/edit_profile.png")
```

## Editting Your Personal Information

Your profile contains your publicly visible personal information. In this section, you can add and update your name and ORCID, select your institutional affiliation, and add a link to a relevant website.

```{r echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics("img/edit_profile_2.png")
```

## Editting Your Account Information

Your account contains your login information and two-factor authentication status.
